title: rosa micrantha var. vallesiaca
intro: Rosa micrantha var. vallesiaca, commonly known as Alpine Rose or Rosa vallesiaca, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. The plant is known for its health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin, as well as alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Rosa micrantha var. vallesiaca include its potential to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent, which can help to promote wound healing, reduce pain and inflammation, and tone the skin. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as geraniol and linalool, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
